title.zh: 让感受、可选回应与决定各有一句话
title.en: Give the feeling, available responses and decision a sentence each

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的临时改见面地点，先分别写下：哪里让你不快、交通条件允许哪些回应、这次准备怎样答复。可以直接拒绝，也可以先核对交通；不必等情绪消失。再比较一次无需停顿就知道答案的情境，看看条件有何不同。复盘关注选择是否适合当时条件，不计等待了几分钟，也不以语气温和、对方满意或下次均分提高为目标。
paragraphs.en: For the changed meeting location above, separate what bothered you, which replies transport conditions allowed and the reply you chose. Declining directly or checking transport first can both fit; the feeling need not disappear. Compare an occasion when you knew your answer immediately and consider what differed. Review the choice in its circumstances without counting minutes of delay or targeting a gentle tone, the other person’s approval or a higher mean next time.

title.zh: 围绕一件日常小事交流做法
title.en: Discuss approaches to one ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果临时换地点让你不方便，你希望先核对什么，哪些情况下可以直接说不去？”交换可行做法与条件即可，不用比较谁更成熟，也不要求对方重述私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a changed meeting location inconvenienced you, what would you check first and when might you simply decline?” Exchange feasible approaches and conditions without ranking maturity or requesting a private story.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明；链接不含本次答案、均分或资料完整度。对方可以不回答，也可以选择另一份说明开始聊。四部分没有高低顺序，不用补做测试才能参与讨论。

title.zh: 把原约定、变化和可完成范围放在一起
title.en: Place the agreement, changed conditions and feasible scope together

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的活动照片整理，区分原先双方确认了什么、现在的时间怎样变化、你仍愿意且能够完成哪一部分。可以提出缩减、改期或退出，再留出对方回应的空间；讨论不保证达成一致。回顾信息是否传达到需要知道的人，也看看一开始是否说清范围。无需先承担全部责任来证明诚意，更不把超量完成当成成熟。个人原因可以保留，公开说明不替任何一方裁决义务。
paragraphs.en: Return to sorting the event photographs: distinguish what was agreed, how available time changed and which part you still want and are able to undertake. Propose reducing, postponing or leaving the task and allow a response; agreement is not guaranteed. Review who needed the update and whether the original scope was clear. Taking all responsibility or doing extra work is no proof of maturity. Private reasons can remain private, and this guide cannot settle either person’s obligations.

title.zh: 围绕一件日常小事交流做法
title.en: Discuss approaches to one ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果整理照片的可用时间变少，怎样说明已完成部分与需要重新商量的范围？”交换可行做法与条件即可，不用比较谁更成熟，也不要求对方重述私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If time for sorting the photographs shrank, how would you distinguish the completed part from the scope needing discussion?” Exchange feasible approaches and conditions without ranking maturity or requesting a private story.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明；链接不含本次答案、均分或资料完整度。对方可以不回答，也可以选择另一份说明开始聊。四部分没有高低顺序，不用补做测试才能参与讨论。

title.zh: 给一句含糊回复保留未确认的部分
title.en: Leave the unconfirmed part of an ambiguous reply open

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的“到时看看”，把对方原话与你补出的意思分开。如果安排确实需要答复，可以问一个与时间有关的问题，并说明自己何时需要定下来。对方可以不知道、不解释或不参加；没有得到答案的部分仍可标成未确认，而不是补成拒绝或默认同意。再比较一次不宜继续追问的情境。复盘不要求猜中对方心理，也不以多问、让步或继续维持交流作为成绩。
paragraphs.en: For “we’ll see” above, separate the words from the meaning you supplied. If the arrangement needs an answer, ask one timing question and explain when you need to decide. The person may remain unsure, give no explanation or decline. An unanswered part can stay unconfirmed instead of becoming a refusal or assumed agreement. Compare an occasion when further questions would be unwelcome. Review without trying to read a mind or treating more questions, concessions or continued contact as success.

title.zh: 围绕一件日常小事交流做法
title.en: Discuss approaches to one ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“听到“到时看看”，哪些信息真的需要确认，哪些可以留给对方不解释？”交换可行做法与条件即可，不用比较谁更成熟，也不要求对方重述私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “After “we’ll see,” what actually needs confirmation and what can remain unexplained by the other person?” Exchange feasible approaches and conditions without ranking maturity or requesting a private story.

title.zh: 把想要的选择与愿意接受的帮助分别说清
title.en: Distinguish the choice you want from the help you welcome

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的休闲课程选择，先说这次在意的条件，再区分自己想保留的决定、愿意听的建议和希望别人协助的信息。可以共同决定、暂缓或不报名；接受更多帮助也不抵消自己的理由。比较一次现实条件使选择暂时不可行的情况，别把有限空间归咎于个人不够独立。复盘关注帮助的范围是否合适，不比较谁更少依赖别人，也不要求公开家庭或照护安排。
paragraphs.en: Return to the leisure class: name what matters this time, then distinguish decisions you want to retain, advice you welcome and information you would like help obtaining. Decide together, postpone or skip enrolment; more help does not cancel your reasons. Compare a choice that circumstances made unavailable rather than attributing limited options to insufficient independence. Review whether the scope of help fits without comparing who relies on others less or disclosing family or care arrangements.

title.zh: 围绕一件日常小事交流做法
title.en: Discuss approaches to one ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果考虑上一门休闲课，哪些决定希望自己保留，哪些帮助会让选择更方便？”交换可行做法与条件即可，不用比较谁更成熟，也不要求对方重述私人经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “When considering a leisure class, which decisions would you retain and what help would make choosing easier?” Exchange feasible approaches and conditions without ranking maturity or requesting a private story.
